graph_name: Secret Knock Door Lock — Nexus Map

nodes.label: Desktop Reference Image
nodes.description: The annotated 3D rendering on the user's Desktop that defines the target visual style and component layout.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Defines what every component must look like and where it sits.

nodes.label: Visual Reference Analysis
nodes.description: JSON + markdown extraction of all components, colors, and arrows from the reference image.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Drives all geometry decisions.

nodes.label: Door Panel
nodes.description: Vertical wood-plank door surface that the lock mounts on.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Provides mounting surface; receives mechanical reaction from bolt.

nodes.label: Lock Housing
nodes.description: Dark rectangular case with transparent cover holding all internals.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Contains and aligns every internal component.

nodes.label: Transparent Cover (Cutaway)
nodes.description: Front face of the housing rendered semi-transparent so internals are visible.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Pedagogical — exposes the mechanism.

nodes.label: Knock Sensor Module
nodes.description: Door-mounted vibration / piezo microphone module.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Step 1 — emits a digital pulse to Arduino.

nodes.label: Arduino UNO
nodes.description: Microcontroller that validates the knock pattern.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Step 2 — pattern validation; Step 3 trigger — enables driver.

nodes.label: Battery Pack
nodes.description: Cell holder providing power to driver and Arduino.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Step 3 — sources current.

nodes.label: Motor Driver
nodes.description: Switches battery current to the motor; reverses polarity for relock.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Gates and directs the motor current.

nodes.label: DC Motor (Vertical Mount)
nodes.description: Brushed DC motor mounted with its axis vertical; shaft exits the bottom.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Step 4 — generates torque.

nodes.label: Vertical Motor Shaft
nodes.description: Silver rigid shaft on the motor's vertical axis; visibly rotates with an orange marker stripe.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Mechanical link from motor to gear.

nodes.label: Main Drive Gear
nodes.description: Brass spur gear, 18 teeth, rotates about the same vertical axis as the shaft.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Step 5 — converts torque to tangential force.

nodes.label: Rack Gear
nodes.description: Toothed horizontal bar that meshes with the main gear and drives the bolt.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Translates rotation into linear bolt travel.

nodes.label: Sliding Bolt
nodes.description: Solid bolt body rigidly coupled to the rack; seats into the strike plate.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Step 6 — physically engages or releases the lock.

nodes.label: Strike Plate
nodes.description: Brushed-metal receiver on the door frame.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Step 7 marker — green when bolt has cleared.

nodes.label: Signal Flow (Blue)
nodes.description: Logic-level signals between sensor, Arduino, and motor driver.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Carries the unlock decision.

nodes.label: Power Flow (Yellow)
nodes.description: Battery current to driver and Arduino, then driver to motor.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Energizes the actuator.

nodes.label: Mechanical Motion (Green)
nodes.description: Physical motion arrows along shaft, gear, rack, and bolt.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Visualizes the mechanical chain.

nodes.label: Animation Controller
nodes.description: React state machine that drives unlock and relock sequences.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Sequences every visual cue.

nodes.label: Camera Controller
nodes.description: Camera presets for full / mech close-up / electrical / top / door views.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Helps presenter focus on relevant subsystem.

nodes.label: UI Controls
nodes.description: Sequence buttons, toggles, speed slider, camera presets.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Operator-facing entry points.

nodes.label: Status Panel
nodes.description: On-screen 7-step System Flow with locked/unlocked indicator.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Mirrors the reference image's SYSTEM FLOW legend.

nodes.label: Documentation Pack
nodes.description: All markdown deliverables under docs/.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Supports the class presentation.

nodes.label: Obsidian Vault Notes
nodes.description: Linked markdown notes ready to drop into Obsidian.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Permanent project memory.

nodes.label: MacBook Microphone
nodes.description: Built-in laptop microphone used as an OPTIONAL physical knock-trigger source. Captures the audio transient produced by knocking, tapping, or clapping near the laptop.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Optional substitute for the on-screen knock — feeds the same downstream visuals when enabled.

nodes.label: Web Audio API
nodes.description: Browser audio graph: AudioContext + MediaStreamSource wraps the microphone input.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Bridges the OS microphone into the page's JS sample loop.

nodes.label: AnalyserNode
nodes.description: Web Audio AnalyserNode (fftSize 1024) feeding RMS-amplitude samples into the knock detector each animation frame.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Provides per-frame sound level for transient detection.

nodes.label: Mic Knock Detector
nodes.description: React component that watches AnalyserNode samples, maintains a moving baseline, and fires the unlock command when a transient spikes above (sensitivity threshold) AND (baseline × spikeMultiplier) AND cooldown has elapsed.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Optional alternative entry point for the unlock sequence — fires `play_unlock`.

nodes.label: Mic Sensitivity Threshold
nodes.description: User-adjustable slider [0..1] mapping to detection threshold [0.012 .. 0.30 RMS]. Higher slider value = more sensitive (lower threshold).
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Lets the operator dial in the room's noise floor.

nodes.label: Rack Teeth Detail
nodes.description: 16 trapezoidal steel-blue teeth on the -Z face of the rack, projecting toward the gear. Each tooth is a base+tip compound for visible bevel; uses meshPhysicalMaterial with clearcoat.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Visible coupling element — makes the rack-and-pinion mesh legible to viewers.

nodes.label: Gear/Rack Contact Region
nodes.description: Soft yellow highlight at the fixed gear-tangent point (x=-0.05, z≈0.37). Pulses while motion is active to draw the eye to where torque transfers from gear to rack.
nodes.role_in_unlock_sequence: Pedagogical highlight — does not affect mechanism.
